dedupe_keys.name: worldsensing cmt cloud monitoring of tailings dams and open pit mines

description: A commercial remote monitoring system for geotechnical sensors at tailings dams and open pits. The Worldsensing knowledge centre article says wireless dataloggers collect readings from sensors such as piezometers and send them to the CMT Cloud software or to an on-premise server, so that engineers see data without site visits; it gives the example of a site where 100 piezometers had previously been read by hand. It is a paid product, not a free download; pricing and licence terms are not stated on the page read. Coverage is any site where the hardware is installed. Caveats: the article is vendor material and does not describe alert thresholds or data export formats. For simulation it is a source of near real-time pore pressure and deformation streams that can drive tailings dam stability models and early warning. A related catalogue record is the Seequent solution for tailings storage facilities.
